en: Price tenders, compare quotes and control contracts in one workbook
Price tenders, compare quotes and control contracts
Estimate lines priced by cost code
quantity times labour, material and plant rates for every line; the tender sums them into the direct cost without retyping
every tender shows its price, direct cost, margin and a status that warns before a deadline and flags a price below your minimum margin
Subcontractor quotes ranked in each package
quotes are ranked, compared with the package average and marked as ended when they are no longer valid
Unit rate library with rate age
labour, material and plant per unit give the cost and the price with overhead and profit, and old rates are flagged for review
chance times cost for each risk gives the allowance to carry in the price, with a level for high and medium risks
Contract register with retention and damages
value, retention held, defects period end, payment days and the cap on delay damages for every contract
each milestone shows its share of the value, the amount, the days late and whether it is overdue
amount, premium and days left for every bond and cover, with a warning before it ends
Win rate by project kind and month
tenders won and lost, value won and average margin by kind and by month show where you win and where you only spend time
Lost tenders and the gap to the winner
each loss records the reason and the winning price, and shows how far your price was above it
five scores for each lead give a total and a clear decision against your pass mark

Contract register: value, type, retention and terms
One row for each contract with value, dates, retention, payment terms, defects period and delay damages; the retention held, the defects end date and the phase fill in.

Insurance and bonds for each contract

Win rate by project kind and period

Thank a client for the invitation
Hello {name}, thank you for inviting us to tender. We will send our price by the deadline. Call us if anything changes.
Check in with a past client
Hello {name}, we hope your project is going well. If you plan new work, we would be glad to price it.
Ask a contact for a short call
Hello {name}, it has been {days_since} days since we spoke. Do you have 10 minutes this week to talk about your plans?
Invite a decision maker to meet
Hello {name}, we would like to present our experience on similar projects. When can we meet at your office or on site?
Hello, thank you for your enquiry about "{project}". We will review the documents and come back to you within two working days.
Hello, we are following up on "{project}". Can you confirm the tender deadline and send the drawings and the specification?
Hello, to price "{project}" correctly we would like to visit the site. Which day and time suits you this week?
Hello, thank you for inviting us to tender for "{project}". Our team is fully booked, so we must decline this time. We hope to work with you later.
Hello, we submitted our tender for "{project}" with a price of {bid}. Please tell us when you expect a decision.
Hello, we are pricing "{project}" and need an answer to a question about the drawings. The deadline is {deadline}. When can we talk?
Hello, we ask for a short extension of the deadline of {deadline} for "{project}" so that we can price it with firm subcontractor quotes.
Hello, we are waiting for the result of the tender for "{project}" at {bid}. Is there any news or a question about our price?
Thank a client for the award
Hello, thank you for awarding us "{project}". We will send the contract documents and a start plan this week.
Ask for a debrief after a loss
Hello, thank you for the chance to tender for "{project}". Could you tell us how our price compared and what we can do better next time?
Extend the validity of a price
Hello, our price of {bid} for "{project}" is still open. Please tell us if you need it to stay valid for longer.
Hello, we invite you to quote for the {package} package of "{proj}". Please send your price by {valid} with your inclusions and exclusions.
Remind a subcontractor of a quote
Hello, a reminder for your quote for {package} on "{proj}". We close our price soon. Can you send it today?
Tell a subcontractor you plan to use it
Hello, we plan to use your quote of {amount} for {package} on "{proj}" if we win the contract. We will send the subcontract soon.
Tell a subcontractor they lost the quote
Hello, thank you for quoting for {package} on "{proj}". We chose another quote this time. We will invite you again.
Ask for a quote to stay valid
Hello, your quote for {package} on "{proj}" ended on {valid}. Can you confirm that the price of {amount} still holds?
Ask a client to sign the contract
Hello, the contract for "{name}" at {value} is ready. Please sign it before {start} so that we can start on time.
Hello, we start "{name}" on {start}. Please confirm that the site is clear and that we can have access that morning.
Hello, the defects period of "{name}" ends on {defects_end}. Please send us any defect you have found before that date.
Warn a client of a coming milestone
Hello, the milestone "{milestone}" of "{proj}" is due on {due}. We would like you to inspect it with us.
Hello, the milestone "{milestone}" of "{proj}" is {delay} days late. We are working on a catch-up plan and will send it today.
Ask for payment after a milestone
Hello, the milestone "{milestone}" of "{proj}" is complete. Please confirm it and release {amount}.
Ask a provider to renew cover
Hello, our cover for "{proj}" ends on {expiry}. Please send the renewal terms and premium this week.
Hello, our cover for "{proj}" ended on {expiry}. We need a renewal certificate urgently. Please call us.
Ask a supplier for a price
Hello, please send your current price for {item}, the delivery time and how long the price is valid.
Hello, your price for {item} rose to {price}. Can you hold the price for our tenders for the next 60 days?
Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

We are pleased to submit our tender for this project. Our price is {col:tenders.bid}. It is based on the documents we received on {col:tenders.received} and on the assumptions and exclusions listed in our tender.
Our estimator for this tender is {col:tenders.estimator}. We confirm that the price stays valid for the period stated in the tender documents.
We would be glad to meet you to explain the price, the programme and the way we would organise the site.
To {col:tenders.client_name}. Project: {col:tenders.project}. The tender deadline is {col:tenders.deadline}.
While pricing this tender we found points in the drawings and the specification that need your answer. Please reply in writing so that every bidder has the same information.
We will list your answers in the assumptions of our tender. Please reply before the deadline so that we can finish our price in time.

We invite you to quote for this package using the drawings and the scope we send with this letter. Please state what your price includes and excludes, your programme and the days your quote stays valid.
We ask for your quote by {col:quotes.valid}. We compare the quotes for price, programme, experience and safety record.
Letter of intent to a subcontractor
We intend to place this package with you at your quoted price of {col:quotes.amount}, if we are awarded the contract. This letter is not an order. Please keep your price and your programme available.
We will send the subcontract for signature as soon as the client confirms the award.
Letter asking a client for feedback after a lost tender
Thank you for considering our tender. We understand that another contractor was chosen. We would be grateful if you could tell us where our price, programme or experience fell short.
Your feedback helps us improve our future tenders, and we would be happy to price your next project.
Thank you for inviting us to tender. After reviewing our current work and the time available, we must decline this time. We hope you will think of us for future projects.
We value our relationship with you and would be pleased to be invited again.
Notice of a site visit before tender
We ask for safe access to the site and for a person who can show us the boundaries, the existing services and the places for deliveries and cabins.
We will wear protective equipment and record what we see so that the price allows for the real site conditions.

Open Start and type your company name and your own rules in the yellow cells: overhead, profit, target and minimum margin, contingency, price rise, warning days and the score needed to bid.
Fill Clients and Client Contacts. Leads, tenders, wins, win rate and contract value for each client fill in from the other sheets.
Record every enquiry on Leads and score it on Bid Reviews. The decision compares the total with your pass mark.
Enter each tender on Tender Register with its deadline and price. Direct cost comes from Estimate Lines, then margin, days to the deadline and the status fill in.

Price a tender on Estimate Lines: choose the tender and cost code, then type the quantity and the rates for each unit. Keep standard rates on Unit Rate Library, Labour Rates, Material Prices and Plant Hire Rates.
Log every subcontractor quote on Subcontractor Quotes. Each quote is ranked inside its package and compared with the average.
Write what you found on Site Visits, price the dangers on Risks and Allowances, and state what the price leaves out on Exclusions.
When a tender is won, add it to Contract Register with value, retention, payment days, defects months and damages for each day late, then list its Contract Milestones and its Insurance and Bonds.
Record each lost tender on Lost Tenders with the reason and the winning price, and read Win Rate by Kind and Tender Months to see where you win.

Use the 14 calculators for the estimate, markup and margin, price check, overhead, unit rate, contingency, bid or no bid, cash-flow curve, retention, delay damages, price rises, win rate needed, quote levelling and the deadline plan.
